summary: Updated Samsung Electronics' Vienna-traded common GDR review with detailed Q2 2026 primary evidence and the July 30 volume anomaly. Record revenue, Device Solutions profit, operating cash flow, cash, and net cash strengthen the AI-memory thesis and explain the results-day rebound and relative volume spike, while Device eXperience's operating loss adds contrary evidence. The anomaly cleared on July 31, but turnover remained only eight units. Missing fresh KRW/EUR and same-timestamp cross-venue parity, uncertain through-cycle normalization, and negligible Vienna liquidity still prevent a supportable instrument-level valuation. The new schema-v2 assessment is medium-confidence, unsupported, ineligible, and watch-only with explicit valuation and liquidity blockers. No strategy, idea follow-up, or paper order was created because there are no payload-linked or accepted canonical ideas and the conviction gate fails.

evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic market and indicator caches
evidence.claim: The canonical alert period was 2026-07-02 through 2026-07-30. SSU.VI closed at EUR 3,550 on July 30, down 11.47132169576059850374064838% over the period but up 10.24844720496894409937888199% for the session; 56 units traded and volume anomaly entered at strength 1.04706207. On July 31 the close was EUR 3,650 on eight units and the current indicator cache had no active trigger.

Samsung reported Q2 revenue of KRW 171.5 trillion, operating profit of KRW 89.5 trillion, net profit of KRW 71.6 trillion, and common-share EPS of KRW 10,849. Device Solutions produced KRW 127.5 trillion of sales and KRW 89.2 trillion of operating profit, cash reached KRW 190.0 trillion, debt fell to KRW 22.4 trillion, and operating cash flow reached KRW 105.08 trillion; Device eXperience posted a KRW 0.8 trillion operating loss.

Issuer listing evidence identifies the common GDR as ISIN US7960508882 and one GDR as representing 25 Korean common shares. The reviewed immutable identity remains SSU.VI/XWBO/EUR and is distinct from the preferred GDR and Korean ordinary lines.

Assessment assessment_8e31b574b5b937920756 is schema version 2, links predecessor assessment_439df8789aacd897b657, uses the current EUR 3,650 mark and identity-matched EUR/EUR rate of 1, and is deterministically classified unsupported, ineligible, unrated, and watch-only with liquidity_insufficient and valuation_unsupported hard blockers.
